January.origin: The month to eat a lot due to abundance of food

February.origin: Signifies a time where elephants are born

March.origin: Elephants are fully grown at this time

April.origin: Autumn sets in. It is cold and there is need for domestic fire

June.origin: Aloe is thriving; soil is more on the dry side

Saturday.origin: meaning last encounter or closure. Derived from this being the designated day for burials

Nail.meaning: To hit the nail on the head

Take.meaning: To take what does not belong to you forcefully

Pass.meaning: To pass people without greeting or acknowledgement

Right.meaning: To do the right thing/ to do something right

Loyal.meaning: To be loyal to a cause

News.meaning: To keep calm in the face of unpleasant news
